Subject: Re: Onboarding question: pilot billing without PO?

Hi Maria —

Appreciate the materials and the quick turnaround. Short answer: our standard policy requires a PO for vendor invoices, but we do have a documented path for short pilots where a PO is not yet available. To proceed with an exception we need: 

- Signed MSA on file (we have the attachment)
- W-9 and Certificate of Insurance (we have those attached)
- Approval from procurement/finance for a one-time PO-waiver (I am looping in Aditya and Monica)
- A clear spend cap and invoice cadence (single invoice at pilot end is fine)

Proposed Redwood controls if we approve an exception:
- One-time exception code (PROC-EXC-XXXX) included on the invoice
- Spend cap of $15,000 for the pilot (can be lowered to your $4.2k)
- Condition: no recurring billing until vendor is created in our vendor portal

If Aditya/Monica approve, we can provision a temporary vendor ID and instruct AP to accept a single invoice to AP@redwood.com with net30 terms. Also please upload the signed MSA + W-9 + COI to our secure onboarding link: https://secure-upload.redwood.com/bluecrest-onboarding (I included the link above).

Two quick asks from our side: can BlueCrest confirm the exact invoice remit email and whether credit card payment is required/preferred?

Thanks — I’ll follow up internally and come back with the exception code.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Head of Finance Ops (acting) | Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.com
